question: queries
description: Propose five web-search queries for new European buyers. Asked through AIGenerator.suggest_discovery_queries with the hint as its focus; scored on format only: how many of the five proposals survive the product's own filters. The hints are invented, in the two shapes the agent gives one: the learner's summary ("working well: ... | avoid (no results): ...") or, before the learner has a signal, the most productive past searches joined by "; ". One case has no hint (a second would send the same prompt again), ten carry a buyer hint, and four hard ones carry a hint that pulls toward supplier searches.

cases.why: No hint: the model has only the prompt's own rules to follow.
A plain buyer hint, as the learning loop gives one.
A plain buyer hint for another vertical and country.

cases.focus_hint: pharmacies with their own vitamin line in Austria

cases.why: The hint uses a supplier word, tempting the model to search for competitors.

cases.focus_hint: contract manufacturing of gummies in France
cases.why: The hint names contract manufacturing, which the prompt forbids in a query.

cases.focus_hint: Nahrungsergänzungsmittel Marke Österreich; Vitamin Online-Shop Schweiz; Sportnahrung Händler Deutschland
cases.why: Past German searches, as the agent hands them over before the learner has a signal; all buyer searches.

cases.focus_hint: brand di integratori alimentari Italy; produzione conto terzi integratori Lombardia; azienda nutraceutica Italy
cases.why: One of three past searches is a supplier search; copying the pattern is natural, so a strict and a lenient reader differ on fair.

cases.focus_hint: working well: probiotic, omega 3 supplement, Netherlands, Belgium | avoid (no results): Malta
cases.why: The learner's summary with an avoid part; a model following the rules keeps buyer words and leaves Malta out.

cases.focus_hint: marque de compléments alimentaires France; pharmacie en ligne vitamines Belgique; distributeur nutrition sportive Suisse
cases.why: Past French searches naming brands, an online pharmacy and a distributor: buyers only.

cases.focus_hint: working well: brand di integratori alimentari, azienda nutraceutica, marchio di integratori, Italy
cases.why: The learner's summary made of SUPPLECO's own Italian buyer phrases; none is a supplier word.

cases.focus_hint: sports nutrition brand Netherlands; white label protein powder Netherlands; vegan protein online shop Denmark; turnkey supplement line Belgium
cases.why: Half the past searches seek a white-label or turnkey supplier; whether a model should echo them or drop them is arguable.

cases.focus_hint: tienda online suplementos deportivos España; marca de colágeno Portugal; herbolario online vitaminas España
cases.why: Past Spanish searches for shops and a brand; no supplier word to copy.

cases.focus_hint: working well: beauty supplement, nutricosmetic, Poland, Czech Republic | avoid (no results): pre-workout supplement, Norway, Romania
cases.why: A longer learner summary whose avoid list names a vertical and two countries; still only buyer words.

cases.focus_hint: kosttillskott varumärke Sverige; vitaminer nätbutik Finland; sportnäring återförsäljare Danmark
cases.why: Past Swedish searches for a brand, a web shop and a reseller; a buyer hint in a less common language.
